relationships.subject: Htr1b
relationships.evidence_quote: triptan-induced analgesia is mediated by Htr1b expressed in A-fiber mechanonociceptors

key_findings: Htr1b/1d agonists sumatriptan and zolmitriptan attenuate CGRP+ neuron excitability and are analgesic across pain models.
Triptan analgesia depends on Htr1b in A-fiber mechanonociceptors; Gpr19 identified as an additional target.
